weak_references.why: owner: a capability that passes every gate is never withheld for a weaker reference; recertified at 200 cases on 2026-10-23
weak_references.note: passed the gates, but the L10 = L_R (C/F)^a part is definitional and the reference restates it (only the reliability multiple is checked independently); withheld under the independence rule until a genuinely different check exists (docs/AUTHORING_A_MODEL.md section 4)

notes.gerber_fatigue_safety_factor: brentq re-solves the Gerber parabola on the load line (the defining equation); the equivalent amplitude in exact sympy arithmetic
notes.asme_elliptic_fatigue_safety_factor: brentq re-solves the ASME ellipse on the load line (the defining equation)
notes.lewis_gear_bending_stress: a cantilever of the inscribed Lewis parabola built from the same form factor Y: the Lewis equation restated
notes.wahl_factor: the factors re-evaluated in exact sympy arithmetic (an empirical formula, no independent route); the stress uses a stress-function torsion constant
notes.marin_endurance_limit: the surface and size factors are the stated empirical power laws re-evaluated with numpy; only the reliability factor comes from an independent route (scipy's normal quantile)
notes.bolt_preload_torque: T = K F d solved for the unknown with sympy in exact arithmetic: the definition restated
